exact.Sin portfolio activo: no hay snapshots q: No active portfolio: there are no snapshots to evaluate.
exact.Snapshot heredado sin provenance de valo: Legacy snapshot with no valuation provenance: the price date at capture is not recorded; left out of the total.
exact.Sin tipo de cambio a fecha del snapshot:: No exchange rate on the snapshot date: left out of the EUR total, value it by hand.
exact.Posición corta (valor negativo): no es u: Short position (negative value): not a foreign asset for Modelo 720 purposes.
exact.Custodia no declarada para esta partida:: Custody not declared for this item: importing from the broker does not prove where it is held. Declare its custody (ISIN/ticker → ISO2 country) in your tax details; until then, it stays out of the total.
exact.Custodia declarada en España: no es bien: Custody declared in Spain: not a foreign asset; it does not count for Modelo 720.
exact.Saldo 0 a 31/12 y cuenta declarada en Es: Balance 0 on 31 Dec and account declared in Spain: not a foreign asset, so it is not part of Modelo 720.
exact.Saldo 0 a 31/12 y sin capturas suficient: Balance 0 on 31 Dec and not enough Q4 captures to compute its average balance: not included in the accounts total. Modelo 720 also looks at the Q4 average balance; if the account had a balance between October and December, check it against the broker statements.
exact.Saldo 0 a 31/12 y saldo medio del 4.º tr: Balance 0 on 31 Dec and Q4 average balance also 0: it adds nothing to the accounts threshold, so it is not included in the total.
exact.Saldo 0 a 31/12 pero saldo medio del 4.º: Balance 0 on 31 Dec but a non-zero Q4 average balance, with no exchange rate: left out of the EUR total, value it by hand.
exact.Sin tipo de cambio para el saldo: fuera: No exchange rate for the balance: left out of the EUR total, value it by hand.
exact.Cuenta declarada en España: no es bien e: Account declared in Spain: not a foreign asset; it does not count for Modelo 720.
exact.Posición actual sin snapshot de valoraci: Current position with no valuation snapshot at year end: left out of the total, value it by hand.
exact.Saldo actual sin snapshot a cierre del e: Current balance with no snapshot at year end: left out of the total, value it by hand.
exact.Sin snapshots de valoración a cierre del: No valuation snapshots at year end: nothing can be stated about this category.
exact.El total computado supera el umbral, per: The computed total is above the threshold, but some items are left out of it: review them anyway.
exact.Hay partidas fuera del total (sin valora: Some items are left out of the total (not valued, custody not verified or an old snapshot): a “below” result would be a false all-clear.
exact.El saldo a 31/12 no supera el umbral, pe: The 31 Dec balance is not above the threshold, but the Q4 average balance is missing (it can also exceed it): inconclusive result.
exact.Los saldos de efectivo no son atribuible: Cash balances cannot be attributed to a portfolio: with several portfolios, the same overall balance being counted twice cannot be ruled out. The category is inconclusive.
exact.El total neto supera el umbral, pero los: The net total is above the threshold, but balances are grouped by currency and not by real account (account number and institution): without that, netting and location by institution cannot be validated. Inconclusive result.
exact.No computable con datos de bróker: los i: Not computable from broker data: foreign real estate is declared separately. Nothing is stated about whether it is above or below the threshold.
exact.Faltan datos identificativos del declara: Declarant identification is missing: the type 1 record requires the tax ID (NIF) and full name, and they are never made up. Save them in your tax details (declarant data).
exact.Falta 'numero_declaracion' válido en tax: A valid declaration number is missing from your declarant data: the spec requires 13 digits starting with 720 (the declaration's sequence number). No file is generated with that field made up.
exact.Falta 'custody' en tax_declarant: mapa p: Custody is missing from your declarant data: a map per item (ISIN/ticker → ISO2 country where it is held or managed, “<CURRENCY> cash” for accounts). The country is not inferred from the ISIN, and no single country is declared for the whole portfolio.
exact.Falta 'filed_720_before' (booleano true/: Whether you filed Modelo 720 before (yes/no) is missing from your declarant data: without the filing history, the origin (A first filing / M change) cannot be assigned without making it up.
exact.Ya se presentó el 720 en ejercicios ante: Modelo 720 was filed in previous years: the origin (A/M) needs the amounts of the last filing to check the combined increase above €20,000 per category, which we don't have. Declare it by hand or provide those amounts.
exact.Contradicción: filed_720_before=false pe: Contradiction: you said Modelo 720 was never filed, but previous-year ISINs are declared. Reconcile the history in your declarant data before generating.
exact.Sin ISIN: la clave 2 (valores sin ISIN): No ISIN: key 2 (securities without ISIN) requires “Z” + issuer country, which is not available. Declare it by hand.
exact.Sin país de custodia declarado para este: No custody country declared for this ISIN in your declarant data: field 129-130 is not inferred. Declare it by hand.
exact.Custodia declarada en España: no es bien: Custody declared in Spain: not a foreign asset, it does not go in Modelo 720.
exact.ISIN declarado el año anterior y ya no p: ISIN declared last year and no longer held: possible DISPOSAL. It needs the actual date it ended; declare it by hand.
exact.La categoría CUENTAS supera el umbral, p: The ACCOUNTS category is above the threshold, but record C requires the account number, the institution's identity and the Q4 average balance: no file is generated for accounts. Declare them by hand.
exact.Ninguna categoría generable supera los 5: No category that can be generated is above €50,000, or every record was excluded for incomplete data. No file generated (check the excluded items and manual review).
exact.Fichero conforme al diseño de registro o: File following the official AEAT record layout (500 bytes, ISO-8859-1): a CALCULATION AID — review it before filing through TGVI Online.
exact.Origen siempre 'A': si la categoría ya s: Origin is always “A”: if the category was already declared and the combined increase exceeds €20,000, “M” applies (see manual review).
exact.Un ISIN comprado en lotes con fechas dis: An ISIN bought in lots on different dates needs one record per lot: here one is generated with the date provided; if there were several dates, review it by hand.
exact.Cuentas (clave C) y bajas no se generan:: Accounts (key C) and disposals are not generated: they need data we don't have (see manual review).
exact.Irlanda va a revisión manual a propósito: Ireland goes to manual review on purpose, not for lack of data: the Spain–Ireland treaty (BOE-A-1994-28597, art. 10.1) sets no single rate for individuals. The 15% of art. 10.1.b only applies if you are entitled to the Irish tax credit on the dividend; otherwise art. 10.1.c makes the dividend exempt in Ireland and the Irish withholding is not deducted in box 0588 but reclaimed from Ireland. Which case applies depends on Irish law, so GerarAI does not compute this deduction: check the withholding on your broker's certificate with an adviser before including it.
exact.Sin tipo de cambio para convertir el div: No exchange rate to convert the dividend or the withholding; it is not part of the deduction.
exact.Fila de caja ambigua (quantity fuera de: Ambiguous cash row (quantity outside {0, 1}) not resolved; the block is not part of the deduction until it is reviewed.
exact.Reversion o ajuste de retencion con vari: Withholding reversal or adjustment with several dividends in the year: it cannot be matched by date to the dividend it came from; assign the reversal to its dividend and recompute the deduction by hand.
exact.País de retención desconocido (sin domic: Withholding country unknown (no issuer domicile); no deduction is computed for this block.
exact.Hay dividendos de emisor español o de pa: There are dividends from Spanish or unknown-country issuers with no exchange rate, withholding or review: the total Spanish withholding cannot be verified.
exact.Ejercicio con conversión de divisa incom: Year with incomplete currency conversion: the balance cannot be used in this report.
exact.Saldos derivados SOLO del libro: no refl: Balances derived ONLY from the ledger: they do not reflect offsets already applied in filed returns or sources outside the ledger. NOT transferable to boxes. Enter the annex C.3 balances of your last return in your tax details (pending prior losses) to publish boxes.
exact.Interés sin importe en EUR (falta el tip: Interest with no EUR amount (the exchange rate for its date is missing or the row is ambiguous): review it by hand.
exact.Los intereses pagados por el margen no s: Margin interest paid is not a deductible expense in an individual's IRPF (Spanish income tax): no expense is allowed for account interest, and for dividends only administration and custody fees are (art. 26.1.a LIRPF; Renta 2025 help manual, section 7.2.3.1). Don't subtract it in the return.
exact.Informe orientativo, no apto para declar: Indicative report, not fit for filing without a tax adviser's validation: wash sales follow the AEAT 2025 Manual procedure (art. 33.5.f LIRPF, proportionality and FIFO); ISIN/listing and multi-broker coverage are not verified.
exact.La cartera no usa EUR como divisa base:: The portfolio does not use EUR as base currency: the Modelo 100 boxes and deduction 0588 are amounts in euros, and figures in another currency are not published. Change the portfolio's base currency to EUR to get the filing layer.
exact.criterio por analogía, sin consulta: criterion by analogy, without a ruling
exact.sin conversiones reales de divisa como e: no real currency conversions as input
exact.falta valor en EUR de un lote consumido: EUR value missing for a consumed lot
exact.lote readquirido sin valor en EUR: repurchased lot with no EUR value
exact.no se garantiza el saldo de divisa anter: the currency balance before the year is not guaranteed

Partidas con snapshot demasiado antiguo ({tickers}): cada valor afirma su 31/12 con SU snapshot; uno reciente no certifica a otro viejo. Resultado no concluyente.
Items with a snapshot that is too old ({tickers}): each item states its 31 Dec value with ITS OWN snapshot; a recent one does not vouch for an old one. Inconclusive result.

Saldo medio del 4.º trimestre ESTIMADO ({list}): faltan saldos diarios y cada día sin captura toma el saldo de la última captura anterior. No es el saldo medio diario exacto que pide el modelo; contrastar con el extracto del banco o bróker.

ESTIMATED Q4 average balance ({list}): daily balances are missing and each day without a capture takes the balance of the previous capture. It is not the exact daily average balance the form asks for; check it against the bank or broker statement.
Sin capturas de saldo suficientes en el 4.º trimestre para reconstruir el saldo medio ({list}): hace falta al menos una por semana del 1/10 al 31/12.
Not enough Q4 balance captures to rebuild the average balance ({list}): at least one per week from 1 Oct to 31 Dec is needed.

Hay carteras con base no EUR ({names}): sus valores (incluidos los vendidos durante el ejercicio, que ya no dejan fila) no son convertibles a EUR a 31/12 sin FX oficial. El total mostrado es solo la parte EUR; la categoría no es concluyente.

Some portfolios have a non-EUR base ({names}): their securities (including those sold during the year, which no longer leave a row) cannot be converted to EUR on 31 Dec without an official FX rate. The total shown is only the EUR part; the category is inconclusive.
Hay carteras con base no EUR ({names}): sus saldos no son convertibles a EUR a 31/12 sin FX oficial. La categoría no es concluyente.
Some portfolios have a non-EUR base ({names}): their balances cannot be converted to EUR on 31 Dec without an official FX rate. The category is inconclusive.
